issue.title: sase screenshot --window SIGUSR2 kills TUIs not launched by sase screenshot
issue.description:
`sase screenshot --window <target>` signals the target pane's pid with SIGUSR2 without checking that the pane is a screenshot-capable TUI. Only TUIs launched by `sase screenshot` (which set `SASE_TUI_SCREENSHOT_DIR` and the `@sase_screenshot_dir` tmux window option) install a SIGUSR2 handler; any other `sase tui` — or a plain shell — gets the default SIGUSR2 action and is terminated.

Suggested fix direction: in `_inspect_tmux_window` / before `_request_export_with_retries`, refuse (clear error, no signal) when the target window lacks the `@sase_screenshot_dir` option (fields[4] empty) — or require an explicit handshake file the TUI writes when it installs the handler. Optionally have every `sase tui` install a harmless SIGUSR2 handler (ignore when no request dir) so a stray signal can never kill a TUI. Also consider the `tui_screenshot.md` memory wording, which suggests `--window` generally.

task_type_fields.impact: Silently kills a user's long-running TUI (or other pane process) whenever an agent or user points --window at a window not created by sase screenshot.
task_type_fields.repro:
1. Run any `sase tui` directly in tmux (e.g. a user's long-lived TUI window `sase:4`), i.e. NOT launched by `sase screenshot`.
2. Run `sase screenshot --window sase:4 -o /tmp/x.png`.
3. `_inspect_tmux_window` reads `#{pane_pid}` and `_request_export_with_retries` runs `kill -USR2 <pane_pid>` (src/sase/screenshot/local.py).
4. `ScreenshotExportMixin._install_screenshot_export_signal_handler` (src/sase/ace/tui/actions/screenshot_export.py) only installs a SIGUSR2 handler when `SASE_TUI_SCREENSHOT_DIR` is set, which only `sase screenshot`-launched windows have. SIGUSR2's default action therefore terminates the TUI process.

Observed 2026-09-30 on apollo: an agent ran `sase screenshot --window sase:4` against the user's own TUI (pid 3120180, running since 2026-09-29); the capture failed and the TUI process was gone right after (user relaunched it at 11:53:28 UTC).

issue.creation_reason: An agent's --window capture of a user's own TUI window terminated that TUI; the command signals arbitrary panes with SIGUSR2 that only screenshot-launched TUIs handle.
